_note: Codex's plugin MCP servers: EXPLICITLY NONE, the reader's ruling of 2026-09-23 (S37). Codex starts a plugin's server in the plugin cache with no MCP roots and none of the session's environment (measured, codex-cli 0.153.4), so a reader served from a Codex plugin could never tell which workspace it answers for; in Codex the reader is the project server `library init` writes into .codex/config.toml. This file must exist and be named by .codex-plugin/plugin.json: with no mcpServers declared, Codex falls back to the plugin root's .mcp.json -- the program's own development config -- and served the PowerShell adapter from it by a relative path (measured the same day). The reader Claude's plugin carries is .codex-plugin/reader.json.
